value.rationale: The result completely classifies both Euclidean radius problems and contact regimes for a natural canonical higher Laplacian family; a parity switch changes inradius from order one to n^(-1/2), and roundness from order n to n^(3/2), while all pairwise edge lengths become asymptotically equal. It exposes metric behavior not captured by the published lattice data and gives a concrete dimension-dependent instability of nearly equilateral simplex geometry.
